How do I use it correctly to get the best result?
To get the best result, start with clean, oil-free lashes using Pre-Cleanse, then apply thin coats of Whisper Light Bond to your natural lashes and wait 30–60 seconds until it feels tacky.
Place your Gossamer® lashes on the underside of your natural lashes 1–2mm away from your waterline, and use the Fuse Control® Wand with Wandoms to press them securely in place. Is there anything else I can help you with?
